_INTERNAL: PRIVATE build/deploy tool — NEVER served on the console, never public. Users never see pools, optimizer settings, or the foundation. This file lives in deploy/, not public/.
_doc: OPTIMIZER POOL + DEPLOY MODEL — source of truth for per-(contract,chain) optimizer settings and codehashes for OUR OWN foundation deploys. Run deploy/sync_optimizer_pool.sh to fill init_codehash / deployed_codehash / runtime_bytes.
_business_model: POSSESSIO owns ONE pool (its reservoir). The console is a PAID auto-deploy gate: a user connects a wallet, pays our fee, and the factory auto-deploys THEIR operational contracts (payments, v2.6.3, x402). We never deploy a pool for anyone — the fees feed OUR pool. Optimizer settings are baked into the template bytecode the factory deploys; the user never sees or sets them.
_model: THREE TIERS. (1) FOUNDATION — salt pool, protocol pool, factory: OUR private one-time manual deploys, in order, each proven before the next. Deploy once, work forever. NOT on the console. (2) AUTO-DEPLOY — payments, v2.6.3, x402Core: the paid product. Deployed FROM the foundation (factory + salt rail, deterministic) when a paying user triggers it. These three are what the console lists. (3) PREREQUISITE / LATER — the rest (whisky, Ethereum anchor): separate phases, prerequisites (grant, liquidity, Fundstrat) first. RULE: the factory pins a template's init_codehash IMMUTABLY at deploy — freeze the auto-deploy templates' optimizer profiles BEFORE the factory goes live.

hot.for: small + called constantly — cheap runtime forever

l1.for: Ethereum L1 — balance expensive deploy vs expensive runtime

contracts.name: PossessioSaltPool
contracts.reason: one-time. The deterministic-address rail the factory and the auto-deploy set deploy onto. First.

contracts.name: PossessioPool
contracts.role: protocol pool — CONFIRM this is the 'protocol pool'
contracts.reason: one-time. Deployed after the salt rail, before the factory. CONFIRM: PossessioPool.sol is the 'protocol pool' you deploy here (vs the v2.6.3 hook, which auto-deploys in tier 2).

contracts.name: PossessioFactory
contracts.reason: one-time — deploy once, works as designed forever. From its existence, tier 2 auto-deploys. Pins template init_codehash(es) IMMUTABLY at construction — so the auto-deploy templates' profiles must be frozen BEFORE this deploys.
contracts.pins_template: the auto-deploy set (v2.6.3 / payments / x402 as applicable)

contracts.name: PossessioPayments
contracts.reason: auto-deployed from the foundation. Hit on every payment — runs=10000 for cheap runtime. Its build must be frozen before the factory pins it.

contracts.name: STEEL
contracts.reason: auto-deployed with v2.6.3; must precede its hook. Shares the v2.6.3 compilation (runs=1).

contracts.name: PossessioHook
contracts.reason: auto-deployed from the foundation. Needs a MINED hook address (V4 permission bits). runs=1 REQUIRED to fit under 24KB.

contracts.name: PossessioX402Core
contracts.reason: auto-deployed from the foundation. Called per-trade — runs=10000. Frozen before the factory pins it.

contracts.name: PossessioWhiskyMarket
contracts.reason: not part of the core launch — a later phase once its prerequisites (§7 legal, B20 issuance) are met.

contracts.name: L1AnchorFactory
